title: Image Quality Assessment and Reliability Analysis of Artificial Intelligence-Based Tumor Classification of Stimulated Raman Histology of Tumor Biobank Samples
summary: CNN tumor classification is assessed on fresh, frozen, and biobank pathology samples with reported reliability results. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
